en: Monochrome blue-toned postcard view across a river toward a hilltop castle complex with steep roofs and a round tower, with a church spire behind it. Riverside houses and a small boat in the foreground. Printed caption at top left reads "Meissen. Königl. Albrechtsburg." Publisher credit along the right edge reads "343. Brück & Sohn, Meissen." There is a handwritten message along the bottom margin.
